import unittest
from textutils import slugify, word_count, truncate


class TextUtilsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_slugify_lower_and_collapse(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  Ola   Mundo  "), "ola-mundo")

    def test_word_count(self):
        self.assertEqual(word_count("a b  c"), 3)

    def test_truncate_cuts_long_text(self):
        self.assertEqual(truncate("Ola Mundo", 5), "Ola M...")

    def test_truncate_returns_same_when_short(self):
        self.assertEqual(truncate("oi", 10), "oi")

    def test_truncate_exact_length(self):
        self.assertEqual(truncate("abc", 3), "abc")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

---
</external_content>
